hierarchy.hero_title: font-fredoka text-5xl md:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.1] text-[#1D3557]
hierarchy.section_title: font-fredoka text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold text-[#1D3557] tracking-tight mb-4
hierarchy.program_badge: font-fredoka text-lg md:text-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
hierarchy.card_title: font-fredoka text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-[#1D3557] mb-2

typography.guidelines: Use 'Fredoka' for all headings to maintain the playful, K-9 appropriate brand identity, while ensuring the scale is massive enough (text-4xl to text-6xl) to immediately grab the attention of school administrators. Body text must remain highly readable.

stickers.badge_base: inline-block px-4 py-2 border-[3px] border-[#1D3557] rounded-full shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#1D3557] transform

bento_grid.card_wide: md:col-span-2 p-6 md:p-8 bg-white border-[3px] border-[#1D3557] rounded-2xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1D3557]
bento_grid.card_standard: md:col-span-1 p-6 bg-white border-[3px] border-[#1D3557] rounded-2xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1D3557]

icons.wrapper: w-12 h-12 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#1D3557] flex items-center justify-center mb-4 text-2xl shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#1D3557]

layouts.section_spacing: py-20 md:py-28 px-6 md:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto

hero_section.left_column: Title: 'Beyond academics: raise students who understand money and think like builders.' (text-5xl/6xl). Description: 'Coinquest brings financial literacy and entrepreneurship programs into your school...' CTA: Single 'Enquire Now' button, massive, yellow bg.
hero_section.right_column: Leave visually blank (empty div with lg:min-h-[400px]). NO PLACEHOLDER GRAPHIC OR TEXT.

program_1_section.header_treatment: Badge: 'Program 1' in Teal (#06D6A0) sticker style (-rotate-2). Title: 'Financial Literacy' (massive, text-5xl). Subtitle: e.g., '36 hours of hands-on learning'.
program_1_section.layout: Bento Grid (3 columns max). Card 1 (Wide, col-span-2): 'What students walk away with'. Card 2 (col-span-1): 'Who delivers it'. Card 3 (col-span-1): 'What we provide'. Card 4 (col-span-1): 'How it fits your schedule'. Card 5 (col-span-1): 'Everything print-ready'.
program_1_section.card_styling: Each card must have a distinct icon wrapped in a colored block (e.g., Teal, Yellow, Light Cyan) with thick borders. Remove all CTA buttons from within the cards.

program_2_section.header_treatment: Badge: 'Program 2' in Coral (#EE6C4D) sticker style (rotate-2). Title: 'Entrepreneurship Workshop'.
program_2_section.layout: Identical Bento Grid structure to Program 1. Card 1 (Wide): 'What students walk away with'. Card 2: 'Who delivers it'. Card 3: 'What we provide'. Card 4: 'How it fits your schedule'. Card 5: 'Culmination day on campus'.
program_2_section.card_styling: Use Purple (#5B21B6) and Coral (#EE6C4D) for icon wrapper backgrounds to distinguish from Program 1. Remove all CTA buttons.

comparison_section.title: 'Which one fits your school?' centered, text-4xl.
comparison_section.table_styling: Render as a responsive thick-bordered card layout. Use a grid or table element wrapper with border-[3px] border-[#1D3557] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-[8px_8px_0px_#1D3557].
comparison_section.table_rows: 7 Rows: 'Who teaches', 'Hours', 'Scheduling', 'What we provide', 'Prep for your staff', 'Students walk away with', 'Best for'.
comparison_section.table_columns: Column 1: Features (bg-gray-50/50). Column 2: Program 1. Column 3: Program 2. Add border-b-2 border-[#1D3557] to rows.

final_cta_section.layout: Centered layout, max-w-3xl mx-auto text-center py-24.
final_cta_section.content: Heading: 'Get started now' (text-5xl). DO NOT include the 3-step flow. Action: Single large 'Enquire Now' button.

dialogs.enquire_now: All 'Enquire Now' buttons must trigger the shared school-enquiry lead form dialog. Ensure data-testid='enquire-now-button' is present on all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over color backgrounds meets WCAG AA standards. #1D3557 over #FFD23F, #E0FBFC, and #FDF6E3 is highly accessible.
accessibility.focus_states: All buttons and interactive elements must have focus-visible:outline-dashed focus-visible:outline-4 focus-visible:outline-[#5B21B6] focus-visible:outline-offset-4.

universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
universal_guidelines.no_transparent_headers: Header backgrounds must have solid or glassmorphism backgrounds to prevent text overlay issues.
universal_guidelines.file_extensions: Use .js files for React components as specified, avoiding TypeScript syntax.
universal_guidelines.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts except for the final CTA. Rely on the heavy stroke borders, bold neo-brutalist shadows, and bento-grid layouts to establish a premium yet playful brand identity.
